Hi Claire — thanks for the notes and the PO. Short answers below and a proposed next step.

1) Format: we support PDF + XML invoice payloads. If you prefer Peppol/UBL XML, we can generate UBL 2.1 and include the Redwood invoice XML schema. We also support a minimal PDF-only delivery if that's simplest for your AP.

2) Delivery options: two common flows we run for EU customers:
   - Portal (recommended): Novaturf receives invoices via your supplier portal (we can push via API/SFTP/Peppol). Portal onboarding reduces duplicate tickets and provides structured validation.
   - Email copy: invoices delivered to finance+invoices@novaturf.com as PDF (and XML attached if you want). This is faster to start but requires AP to manually ingest.

3) Payment collection: SEPA is fine. We don't require a mandate when paying to our bank account if you remit directly via IBAN/BIC; for debit mandates we can provide instructions but it's not required for outgoing transfers.

4) VAT: please send your VAT registration certificate (if you have one) and also confirm your VAT number to place on the invoice. I'll attach Redwood's billing address and VAT info in my next message.

Next step: if you want portal onboarding, can you confirm the contact who will provision us (portal admin), and whether you prefer Peppol or SFTP? If email is easier to start, we can email the first two invoices and switch to portal on the next billing cycle.

I've copied Marissa (billing ops) and Sean (collections) to coordinate the onboarding.

Best,
